Docs / Validators Hub

Validators & Claims Hub

Deterministic, AST-aware invariants enforced by the AFWE kernel before Git commits.

forbid_symbol Deterministic
AST Structural Claim

Forbids forbidden AST symbol definitions (functions, classes, structs) in scoped files using Tree-Sitter parsing.

{ "type": "forbid_symbol", "symbol": "raw_sql_query", "files": ["src/api/**"] }
export_exists Deterministic
AST Structural Claim

Verifies that a public exported symbol exists in the parsed AST, preventing silent deletion of required API functions.

{ "type": "export_exists", "symbol": "process_payment", "files": ["src/payments/mod.rs"] }
symbol_signature Deterministic
AST Structural Claim

Validates that a symbol signature contains specific required parameter substrings without running an external compiler.

{ "type": "symbol_signature", "symbol": "checkout", "contains": "tenant_id: &str" }
must_not_depend Deterministic
Boundary Constraint

Enforces directional architecture isolation: refuses any import or symbol reference crossing forbidden subsystem boundaries.

afwe blueprint constrain Payments --must-not-depend UI --why "Headless worker isolation"
may_depend_only Deterministic
Boundary Constraint

Whitelist boundary rule: guarantees a module only imports strictly authorized dependencies.

afwe blueprint constrain Identity --may-depend-only Database,Shared --why "Zero business logic leaks"
blank_comments Deterministic
ReBorn AST Normalizer

Tree-Sitter comment-blanking engine. Strips inline and doc comments before regex pattern checks to eliminate false positives in URLs and explanations.

// Automatically applied to all pattern checks in AFWE ReBorn Phase 0-4
